normalization_rules.name: Well name title case
normalization_rules.description: Convert WELL_NAME to Title Case instead of all caps

normalization_rules.name: Pad UWI to 16 characters
normalization_rules.description: Left-pad UWI with zeros to ensure 16-char fixed width

normalization_rules.name: Strip dashes from UWI
normalization_rules.description: Remove dashes from UWI to produce numeric-only identifier

normalization_rules.name: Formation name upper case
normalization_rules.description: Ensure STRAT_NAME is upper case for PPDM code consistency

normalization_rules.name: Strip spaces from UWI
normalization_rules.description: Remove all internal spaces from UWI

validation_rules.name: KB elevation above ground elevation
validation_rules.description: Kelly bushing elevation must be >= ground elevation

validation_rules.name: Ground elevation reasonable range
validation_rules.description: GROUND_ELEV should be between -500 and 6000 metres

validation_rules.name: KB elevation reasonable range
validation_rules.description: KB_ELEV should be between -500 and 6100 metres

validation_rules.name: Spud before abandonment
validation_rules.description: SPUD_DATE must be <= ABANDONMENT_DATE if both present

validation_rules.name: Completion before abandonment
validation_rules.description: COMPLETION_DATE must be <= ABANDONMENT_DATE if both present

validation_rules.name: Survey inclination range
validation_rules.description: INCLINATION must be between 0 and 180 degrees

validation_rules.name: Survey azimuth range
validation_rules.description: AZIMUTH must be between 0 and 360 degrees

validation_rules.name: TVD not greater than MD
validation_rules.description: TRUE_VERTICAL_DEPTH must be <= MEASURED_DEPTH at each station

validation_rules.name: Strat top shallower than base
validation_rules.description: TOP_MD must be < BASE_MD if both present

validation_rules.name: First prod before last prod
validation_rules.description: FIRST_PROD_DATE must be <= LAST_PROD_DATE if both present

validation_rules.name: Well name pattern check
validation_rules.description: WELL_NAME should not contain unusual special characters

validation_rules.name: Source populated
validation_rules.description: SOURCE must not be empty on any row

validation_rules.name: Log curve top above base
validation_rules.description: TOP_DEPTH must be < BASE_DEPTH if both present

validation_rules.name: Core top above base
validation_rules.description: TOP_MD must be < BASE_MD for core intervals
